$comment: Single source of truth for installing three.ws inside other agent frameworks. `npm run build:distributions` renders every artifact under distributions/ and public/install/ from this file, and `npm run build:distributions -- --check` fails when anything on disk has drifted. {{...}} placeholders resolve against the top-level keys below. See docs/install-everywhere.md.

server.name: three-ws
server.title: three.ws
server.description: Your three.ws account: agents, avatars, memory, wallets, and the paid tool lanes. Signs in with OAuth 2.1 or an API key.

free.name: three-ws-studio
free.title: three.ws 3D Studio (free)
free.description: Free text-to-3D, image-to-3D, rigged avatars and talking personas. No account, no key.

firstPrompt: Use the three.ws tools to generate a free 3D model of a brass telescope, then give me the viewer link.

frameworks.name: Claude Code

install.label: Install the plugin
install.command: claude plugin marketplace add {{repos.monorepo}} && claude plugin install three-ws@three-ws

frameworks.signIn: Start `claude`, run `/mcp`, choose `three-ws`, press Authenticate and approve in the browser.

frameworks.name: Codex CLI
frameworks.channel: Codex plugin marketplace (reads the same marketplace file as Claude Code)

install.label: Install the plugin
install.command: codex plugin marketplace add {{repos.monorepo}} --sparse .claude-plugin --sparse distributions/three-ws-plugin && codex plugin add three-ws@three-ws

frameworks.signIn: `codex mcp login three-ws` opens the browser; approve and return to the terminal.

alternative.label: Without the plugin system
alternative.command: codex mcp add three-ws --url {{mcp.server.url}} && codex mcp add three-ws-studio --url {{mcp.free.url}} && {{skills.installer}} {{skills.installSource}} --skill '*' -g -a codex -y

frameworks.name: Gemini CLI
frameworks.channel: Gemini CLI extensions gallery (GitHub topic gemini-cli-extension)
frameworks.signIn: Start `gemini` and run `/mcp auth three-ws`; approve in the browser. The free studio server needs no sign-in.

alternative.label: Without the extension
alternative.command: gemini mcp add -s user -t http three-ws {{mcp.server.url}} && gemini mcp add -s user -t http three-ws-studio {{mcp.free.url}} && {{skills.installer}} {{skills.installSource}} --skill '*' -g -a gemini-cli -y

frameworks.name: Hermes Agent
frameworks.channel: three-ws-agent, a downstream distribution of Hermes Agent, plus a plugin for stock Hermes

install.label: Install three-ws-agent (Hermes with three.ws built in)
Install three-ws-agent (Hermes with three.ws built in)

frameworks.signIn: The installer ends with `hermes three-ws setup`, which signs you in. `hermes three-ws login` re-authenticates any time.

alternative.label: Already running Hermes
alternative.command: hermes plugins install {{repos.hermes}}/plugins/three-ws && hermes plugins enable three-ws && hermes three-ws setup

includes: hermes three-ws setup, login and status

frameworks.name: OpenHands
frameworks.channel: OpenHands CLI config recipe, plus an integrations catalog entry for OpenHands/extensions

install.label: Add the servers and skills
install.command: openhands mcp add three-ws --transport http --auth oauth {{mcp.server.url}} && openhands mcp add three-ws-studio --transport http {{mcp.free.url}} && {{skills.installer}} {{skills.installSource}} --skill '*' -g -a openhands -y

frameworks.signIn: Start `openhands`; the three-ws server opens the browser for sign-in on first connect.

frameworks.name: Goose
frameworks.channel: Goose recipe and desktop deeplink (the official MCP Registry lists the server)

install.label: Install the recipe and skills, then start it
install.command: mkdir -p ~/.config/goose/recipes && curl -fsSL https://three.ws/install/goose/three-ws.yaml -o ~/.config/goose/recipes/three-ws.yaml && {{skills.installer}} {{skills.installSource}} --skill '*' -g -a goose -y && goose run --recipe three-ws --interactive

frameworks.signIn: Goose opens the browser on first connect; approve and return to the session.

frameworks.name: Cline
frameworks.channel: Cline CLI, writing the settings file every Cline client shares (VS Code, JetBrains, CLI)

install.label: Add the servers and skills
install.command: cline mcp add three-ws --transport http {{mcp.server.url}} --yes && cline mcp add three-ws-studio --transport http {{mcp.free.url}} --yes && {{skills.installer}} {{skills.installSource}} --skill '*' -g -a cline -y

frameworks.signIn: Open Cline (CLI or editor); the three-ws server opens the browser for sign-in on first connect.

frameworks.name: Continue
frameworks.channel: Continue MCP block files for the IDE extensions and the cn CLI
frameworks.signIn: Continue's editor extension signs in to Streamable HTTP servers with a key, so create one at {{mcp.apiKeyPage}} and save it as {{mcp.apiKeyEnv}}. The free studio server needs none.
